initialExam.title: GPSC 2026 (Gujarat Public Service Commission)
initialExam.description: Gujarat PSC conducts the Gujarat Administrative Service and Gujarat Civil Service examination for recruitment to Class I and Class II posts in Gujarat state government.
initialExam.syllabus: Prelims: General Studies (200 marks), CSAT (200 marks). Mains: Gujarati, English, Essay, General Studies Papers, Optional Subject.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Prelims → Mains → Personal Interview → Document Verification → Final Merit
initialExam.jobRole: Deputy Collector, DSP, Mamlatdar, Section Officer, and other Class I/II posts in Gujarat
initialExam.careerGrowth: Deputy Collector → Additional Collector → District Collector → Commissioner → ACS.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit gpsc.gujarat.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, LTC, Government quarters, Pension, Vehicle allowance

ageLimitDetails.relaxation: OBC: 3 years, SC/ST: 5 years, PwD: 10 years
